name: debug-bench_all_only_input
description: A small diagnostic text benchmark intended to exercise model behavior on input-only examples; it contains prompts designed to test robustness to varied or degenerate inputs. The set is intended for debugging model responses rather than measuring broad capabilities. It is primarily used to identify failure modes and edge cases in text-only settings.
reputation: Very low / niche — primarily used as an internal or debugging dataset rather than a widely cited benchmark.
